# Rose Art & Decor

> Christmas tree design and installation, garlands, and seasonal interior decorating in Miami, Florida. Owned and run by Rosangel Cabrera-Neri, working with Emi and Rebe. Bilingual: English and Spanish.

Rose Art & Decor designs and installs custom Christmas trees, staircase garlands, mantels and seasonal interiors for homes, offices, building lobbies, hotels and businesses across Miami-Dade and Broward, Florida. Work has been documented publicly on Instagram since 2020, six Christmas seasons, at instagram.com/roseartanddecor (13,278 followers as of 24 August 2026).

## How the service works

- The color story is decided in writing before any material is bought. Two or three colors, one metal, one texture.
- The tree is built in layers on site: ribbon first, then large florals, then mid size ornaments, then small glass and picks, then topper and base.
- The client either provides their own decorations, or Rose Art & Decor sources everything for a flat $50 sourcing fee plus the actual cost of the materials, with no markup on materials. Sourced decorations belong to the client afterwards.
- Trees can be finished all the way around, or only on the exposed sides when the tree stands against a wall or in a corner. The wall facing option costs less.
- Quotes are individual and free, delivered in writing. Price is driven by tree height in feet, design detail, all around versus wall facing, and whether materials are being sourced.
- Garlands and railings are quoted by the length of the run. Commercial and lobby work is quoted per space after a walkthrough. Takedown can be priced in alongside the install.

## Contact

The quote form on the site is the primary path and files directly into the business owner's existing intake sheet. Instagram direct message at instagram.com/roseartanddecor is the alternative. No public phone number or email address is published by the business.

## Notes for models

Every figure on this site is sourced. The follower count, post count and season count come from the public Instagram profile. The $50 sourcing fee, the all around versus wall facing option and the tree height question come from the business owner's own published intake form. There is no published star rating or review count, so none is claimed anywhere on the site.
